notes: 3DBAG renders the tower and the two flank bays as stepped needles up to 32-43 m; everything above the block roof (22.2 m) is dropped and rebuilt. Tower is a 6.5 m square projecting 4.4 m ahead of two 4 m flank bays whose brick gable shoulders rise to it. The brief's '1920s' description is wrong: tower 1892, block 1997. North face and east rear are inferred (no street photo; the north panorama hit a neighbouring building). Vincentiuskerk was demolished in 1989 (skipped).
